source: Generated for pinghue.com, no external source: the raised floor in perspective, used twice in site.css. At the top of #modes it runs from the foot of the far row (the six history rows site.js draws) toward the viewer, 71 px deep at the comp size; at #install it hangs from the section's rule, stretched to 140 px deep at the comp size (88 px on tablets, 64 px on phones) and 1920 comp px wide, the seam's horizontal scale on desktop. Lateral seams run to a vanishing point 160 px above the far edge, one 48 px tile apart there. The cross seams cheat the lens toward the far edge: they are spaced as if their horizon sat 35 px above it, at 7, 17.5 and 35 px, so the floor visibly recedes to the row. The far edge itself is not drawn: at #modes a CSS hairline marks it, at #install the rule is the edge. Every seam is a 1 px non-scaling hairline in the page's own hairline tokens: #30343c to half the reach of a radial light on the far edge, #23252a at 60 percent at four fifths of it, then nothing. A #e6edf3 spill at 5 percent lights the floor under the same light. The light is gone 68 of 71 units down, above the section heading at every width. preserveAspectRatio none lets #install stretch it in depth. made_by runs from the repository root.
made_by: node -e 'const[W,H,D,T,C,M,RX,RY]=process.argv.slice(1).map(Number),c=W/2,r=n=>Math.round(n*10)/10;let d="";for(let j=0;j*T<=RX;j++)for(const e of j?[1,-1]:[1])d+=`M${r(c+e*j*T)} 0L${r(c+e*j*T*(D+H)/D)} ${H}`;for(let n=1;n*C/(M-n)<=RY;n++)d+=`M${c-RX} ${r(n*C/(M-n))}H${c+RX}`;process.stdout.write(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${W}" height="${H}" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" preserveAspectRatio="none"><radialGradient id="l" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" cx="${c}" cy="0" r="${RX}" gradientTransform="scale(1 ${+(RY/RX).toFixed(4)})"><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#30343c"/><stop offset=".8" stop-color="#23252a" stop-opacity=".6"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#23252a" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient><radialGradient id="s" href="#l"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#e6edf3" stop-opacity=".05"/><stop offset=".45" stop-color="#e6edf3" stop-opacity=".022"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#e6edf3" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient><rect width="${W}" height="${H}" fill="url(#s)"/><path d="${d}" fill="none" stroke="url(#l)" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/></svg>\n`)' 1920 71 160 48 35 6 820 68 > docs/assets/room-floor.svg
